text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Dwarf bamboo and chameleon plant... 
This should be plenty. 
I can make a lot of wild herb tea with 
this.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Now, speaking of wild herbs this time of 
year—

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text: Yeah, nice reflexes.

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text: You haven't lost your edge, Daring Tact.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I knew it was you 
just from your presence, Titleholder.

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
Impressive as always. 
Well then, let me help you pick wild 
herbs.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Up in the trees— 
...it's bats.

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Being out in nature is great. 
It really sharpens the senses.

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
I never want this wild instinct 
to grow dull.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I feel the same way. 
I want to keep the running nurtured by 
Hidaka's nature 
sharpened to perfection.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Trainer approved it, too. 
Our camping trip tonight, that is.

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
You actually got permission? 
We do this all the time, but you're so 
dutiful.

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
Hm...? This coffee 
smells like spicebush.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I tried adding roasted spicebush to it. 
You remember that mountain you told me 
about? 
The owner there taught me about it.

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, so you went to that mountain. 
How was it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It was delightfully rugged! 
There were even cliffs you'd probably 
love, Titleholder.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Though, there wasn't much sign of 
wildlife. 
Still, the river fish were swift, 
so there are plenty of ways to train 
there!

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Maybe I'll go too. 
So, what about this mountain?

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
Lots of wild animals. Rich vegetation, 
too. 
I think we could do some serious survival 
training here.

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text: Besides... the ocean is close by.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
! That means we can look forward to 
an ocean breeze like back in Erimo!

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. When it comes to training, 
you really can't beat that fierce sea 
wind.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that reminds me. 
Speaking of Erimo's wind, back in the day, 
Titleholder—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
You kept charging into it over and over, 
refusing to lose to the gale... 
until your hair got slicked completely 
back 
and wouldn't return to normal.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that manga-like hairstyle was 
adorable! 
...I wonder if we'll get to see it again 
on that mountain?

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
T-That was back then! I was still 
inexperienced—

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
...To the right, a snake approaching along 
that tree trunk.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
To the left, in the bushes... a raccoon 
dog, or maybe a raccoon.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Titleholder, peacefully now, alright? 
Here goes—

text_block_list.name: Snake & Raccoon Dog
text_block_list.text:
(Hiiissss... Hiiissss...) 
(Rustle rustle!)

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text: FSHUUUUU—!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Snake & Raccoon Dog
text_block_list.text:
(Rustle rustle rustle...) 
(Kyuuu... Patter patter...)

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
Intimidate them like that, 
and they won't come near us for the rest 
of the night.

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Tension where you can't let your 
guard down for a second. 
You can only experience this out in 
nature.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Still... if possible, I'd love to retreat 
into an even harsher mountain, like Erimo. 
Titleholder, will you tell me more about 
that mountain?

In search of Daring Tact, I arrived at the 
forest near the academy, 
where she said she would be having a 
'camp to stay in touch with the wild.'
—Halt.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, just kidding! 
Good morning, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
Your rear was wide open, Trainer. 
You need to stay more alert in the forest.
choice_data_list: If you two were enemies, would I be dead?
If you two were enemies, would I be dead?

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
Your rear was wide open, Trainer. 
You need to stay more alert in the forest.
choice_data_list: If you two were enemies, would I be dead?
If you two were enemies, would I be dead?

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
Pretty much. First, strike the vitals. 
Throw you to neutralize, bind with vines—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Titleholder. 
No fighting, it's dangerous.

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't fight. Just mental imagery. 
Last night, we drove them off purely with 
intimidation, right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Snakes and raccoon dogs are very cautious, 
so they won't approach anything stronger 
than them. 
That is why we drove them off by 
intimidating them.

...I felt like I finally understood what 
she meant by 'staying in touch with the 
wild.' 
Their camping trips were on an entirely 
different level...

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
That's why we camp— 
to keep from losing that edge.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, look at me now! 
My senses are razor-sharp... I feel ready 
to run a great race!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, could you please consider another 
mountain retreat for me? 
Titleholder told me about a wonderful 
mountain!

She truly needs her mountain retreats. 
Seeing how full of life Daring Tact was, 
I became utterly convinced of it.
